ideas.title: The Rise of Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the growing trend of Medicaid fraud, including the use of AI to fake records in Medicaid housing scams
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in the US?
How are scammers using AI to fake records in Medicaid housing scams?
ideas.insight: I believe that Medicaid fraud is a growing concern, and the use of AI to fake records in Medicaid housing scams is a new and emerging trend. I recommend investigating this area further to understand the scope of the problem and how to prevent it.
